label: starter-set note (read me)
note: Jobfaro's STARTER calibration set (1.54.0): 12 synthetic, self-contained JD+CV pairs with hand-banded expectations. `jobfaro calibrate` falls back to this when data/calibration.json doesn't exist — a smoke check that the engine's bands still behave, NOT the N>=50 real-label set the eval-tuning doc calls for (that grows from `jobfaro feedback` thumbs). Each item carries its own cv so expectations don't depend on the user's résumé. This first item has no jd on purpose: calibrate reports it as skipped, proving the skip path stays honest.

label: direct fit — entry data analyst vs analyst grad
jd: Data Analyst (Entry Level) — Columbus, OH. Build SQL queries and Excel dashboards, report KPIs to operations leadership, document data definitions. Requirements: SQL, Excel, strong attention to detail. Nice to have: Python, Tableau. 0-2 years experience. Bachelor's degree in any quantitative field or equivalent practical experience.
cv: Recent graduate, B.S. Statistics. Skills: SQL (3 course projects + internship), Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, dashboards), Python (pandas). Internship: built weekly KPI dashboard for a logistics team; documented metric definitions. Detail-oriented: caught and fixed a systematic reporting error.

label: clear non-fit — registered nurse vs analyst grad
jd: Registered Nurse — Medical ICU, night shift. Provides direct patient care, medication administration, and care planning. Requirements: current RN license, BLS/ACLS certification, 1+ year acute care experience. Associate or Bachelor of Science in Nursing required.
cv: Recent graduate, B.S. Statistics. Skills: SQL, Excel, Python. Internship: KPI dashboards for a logistics team.

cv: Recent graduate, B.S. Statistics. Skills: SQL, Excel, Python. Internship: KPI dashboards for a logistics team.
